# VoVNet

**Category:** CNN · **Code:**
[`timm/models/vovnet.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/vovnet.py) ·
**Architectures:** 10 · **Pretrained weights:** 3 (3 with ImageNet-1k results)

VoVNet uses One-Shot Aggregation (OSA) modules, which concatenate the outputs of all layers of a block once at its end.
VoVNetV2 (from CenterMask) adds residual connections and effective SE (eSE) attention.

## Papers

* [An Energy and GPU-Computation Efficient Backbone Network for Real-Time Object
  Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.09730)
* [CenterMask : Real-Time Anchor-Free Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.06667)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('ese_vovnet39b.ra_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

| [`dynamic_img_size=True`](../model_api#input-size) | – |
| [`set_grad_checkpointing()`](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`VovNet` with `ese_vovnet19b_slim_dw` at 224),
other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page for
details.
